render.energy_rationale: 开场的重量来自停留而不是速度：220 帧里大部分是 hold，只有入场和收尾在动。

intent_zh: 在一个空场里点亮一个主体，让观众先认位置再认内容。
use_zh: logo 前的一拍、章节开场、产品第一次出现在画面里
summary_zh: 聚光灯从上方扫下，主卡在光斑里落位，光斑随后收成一枚圆形遮罩交给下一镜

cast.note: The only reference brief with an establishing frame, because 220 frames is long enough to spend time before moving.

actors.art: a soft elliptical pool of light on an ink background, 40% of frame width
actors.state_out: centred on the card, dimmed to 70%

actors.art: one ledger card, cream on ink, showing a single month total

beats.heading: sweep-in
beats.raw: The pool travels down from above frame.

beats.heading: hold
beats.raw: Long hold. This is where the headline is read.

beats.heading: iris-out
beats.raw: The pool contracts into a circular iris and hands off to the next shot.

parameters.feel: 小于 30% 主体显得被挤压；大于 55% 光斑消失，只剩整体提亮
112 帧是读完一行标题 + 一眼图形的下限；短于 80f 观众来不及读
12 帧让主体像被照亮而不是被开关切换
0.62 保留边缘余量；收到 0.5 会切到主体脸上
衰减到 0.7 让主体仍然是亮点；不衰减会读作逆光剪影
纯黑会让 8bit 编码在边缘产生色带

pitfalls.text: 停留段里不要加任何运动：观众正在读字，动一下就得重读。
聚光位置必须与主体中心重合，偏差超过光斑半径的 1/4 就会读作偏光。
遮罩收拢时不要同时淡出背景，两者叠加会把转场读成黑场。
光斑加噪点在暗部会被读作压缩块效应，不加则 8bit 下有色带。

copy.note: The only reference brief whose copy block is the reason to use this card: it is the opening, and the opening carries the promise.

slots.hint: One line. If a demo uses 2 title words, keep 2 words.
slots.rationale: Six words, 25 characters. It states an outcome rather than a feature, and 'close themselves' is a claim the following 30 seconds actually demonstrate — which is the test we apply to every opening headline.

slots.text: Ledger matches every transaction to its invoice
slots.rationale: Eleven words. Read during the 112-frame hold, which is the only place in the 30s cut with enough dwell time for a sentence of that length.
Two words, and the only CTA in the film. A second CTA anywhere else would compete with it.

notes: The three reference briefs are deliberately spread across the energy range — mid-high, high, mid — because the interesting question is not what a card looks like but what it costs: an 11-frame card cannot hold a sentence, a 220-frame card can hold one and still needs a rule telling you not to move during it.

Every slot here is filled or explicitly omitted with a reason. An omitted slot with no reason is indistinguishable from an unfinished brief, which is why this brief carries one even where the copy exists.
